finalText: All 12 files migrated to `db.execute({ sql, params })` and syntax-checked clean. `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` was intentionally left on `db.query` — it's marked as a vendored copy that gets overwritten wholesale on every upgrade, so local edits there would be lost; that file's `db.query` calls also aren't covered by the deprecation notice's replacement path since it's third-party code, not app code.
